name: Science Olympiad at Illinois
mission: Join Science Olympiad at Illinois to help run regional and state competitions, write and proctor exams, and mentor local teams while building real-world STEM skills, developing volunteer skills, and connecting with a national network of alumni and Illinois educators.
missionStatement: Science Olympiad at Illinois (SOIL) is a student-run organization with the purpose of supporting the Science Olympiad experience for high school students in Urbana-Champaign and the state of Illinois. We strive to include Science Olympiad alumni and students who are interested in supporting Science Olympiad, regardless of personal identity or views. To maintain a strong connection with the Science Olympiad community, our goals are to host a Science Olympiad invitational competition and to provide outreach to current Science Olympiad Division B teams, Division C teams, and with Illinois Science Olympiad (ISO). SOIL also serves to allow University of Illinois students interested in Science Olympiad to engage with the organization at a higher level. Students will have opportunities to help organize competitions at the regional and State level, write and proctor exams, and work with local teams through mentoring.
communityImpact: We're committed to expanding access to STEM throughout Champaign-Urbana and Central Illinois. Our members hope to volunteer as mentors for local middle and high school teams. We also partner with Illinois Science Olympiad to help run regional and state tournaments by writing and supervising events, grading, and handling logistics.

about.science: Science Olympiad brings students together through team-based science and engineering competition. Participants explore scientific knowledge, problem-solving, and hands-on skills.
about.identity: Science Olympiad at Illinois is an independent Registered Student Organization at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. We connect through STEM and service while supporting students and local teams.
about.story: A shared interest in Science Olympiad connects our community. Our verified founding story and milestones will be added here.
